name: Missed Opportunity Recovery
outcome: Turn an unanswered call or inquiry into an owned follow-up task and measure whether it was reached, booked, or closed.
required_inputs: Clinic-approved callback window and message template
Applicable communication consent and suppression state
guardrails: Do not claim a missed call was recovered without an observed outcome.
Do not contact people until provider, consent, opt-out, and legal requirements are approved.
No message bodies or patient identifiers in aggregate metric events.
Never send outreach from a staff member's personal account without authorization.
activation_requirements: Supported telephony or messaging integration configured and tested.
Clinic-approved scripts, operating hours, consent, opt-out and handoff policy.
Idempotency, bounded retries, suppression, monitoring and staff takeover tests.
